title: Chapter 215 Xiao Clan Genius
content:
Chapter 215 Xiao Clan Genius

After watching Xie Lan be taken away, the head of the Xie clan sighed again.

"This girl may hate me for the rest of her life."

On the side, the elder of the Xie clan smiled and said, "Captain, don't worry, Miss Xie Lan will understand your good intentions in the future."

When the head of the Xie clan tribe heard this, he did not speak, but looked up at the sky, and his expression gradually became solemn.

There is exactly the direction of the Xiao clan.

Inside the Xiao clan.

"Great Elder, a lot of aura has appeared outside my Xiao clan."

A spy from Xiao clan stepped forward and said.

Hearing this, Xiao Jing's face turned gloomy, "Continue to stare. If there is any abnormal movement, report it to me immediately."

"Yes, Great Elder."

When she was in place, Xiao Jing looked low, and so did the rest of the Xiao clan.

Now, it is the second day that Xiao Sheng and Lu Daosheng have entered the ancestral mountain.

Nothing came from the ancestral mountain.

In fact, since the accident occurred in the ancestral land, there has never been any movement inside, as if nothing had happened at all.

But the reality is that no one who entered has come out again.

Xiao Jing and others speculated that there should be some breath in the ancestral land that blocked the connection between the outside world and the inside world.

Therefore, those communication objects do not work at all.

"Great Elder, they are coming."

On the side, Xiao Chen said sadly.

Not only Xiao Chen at this moment, but the rest of the Xiao clan looked sad. They had already vaguely guessed what the Xiao clan would face soon.

For a moment, several people began to cry silently.

Seeing this, Xiao Jing angrily scolded, "Why are you crying!"

"I, the people of Xiao clan, are not people who are afraid of life and death? At worst, I will fight them!"

As soon as these words were spoken, everyone also lit up the last trace of fighting spirit in their hearts.

"Yes, at worst, I'll fight them!"

At this time, another Xiao spy came to Xiao Jing's side.

I saw that the spy's body was trembling slightly.

"Great, Great Elder, there are people from three tribes outside, and our Xiao tribe has been surrounded."

The spy used voice transmission, so only Xiao Jing could hear it.

When Xiao Jing heard this, his face looked extremely ugly.

It seems that they are planning to destroy their Xiao clan and eliminate them.

In this way, the idea that Xiao Jing was preparing to take the younger generation of the Xiao clan out secretly was completely eliminated.

"hateful!"

Xiao Jing clenched his fists, and his hatred for the three tribes reached its peak.

And at this moment, a sound that made everyone present familiar with suddenly sounded.

"Dear seniors, Xiao Luo is late."

Everyone looked in the sound and saw a young man in his prime. Although he looked a little immature, he felt a sense of vicissitudes deep in his eyes.

"Young Master Luo, why are you back?"

Xiao Luo, the son of the leader of the Xiao clan.

He is now the most genius of the Xiao clan. Even in the entire fairyland, he is a famous existence.

Seeing Xiao Luo, a hint of fear appeared in Xiao Jing's eyes.

"Great Elder, now my Xiao clan is in danger. Do you still want to hide it from me?"

At this moment, Xiao Luo was filled with anger.

If someone hadn't reminded me, I'm afraid that the Xiao clan would have been destroyed and he would not have come back.

"you!"

"oops--"

Xiao Jing pointed to Xiao Luo in front of him, and the sadness in his eyes could no longer be suppressed.

"What's the point of coming back?"

"If they were in the academy, they wouldn't do anything to you, but now you are back, they will definitely eradicate you."

Xiao Jing was a little embarrassed.

Originally, Xiao Luo was not in the Xiao clan, but in a force in the Immortal Realm called Tiandi Academy.

This force, no matter who is in the world, as long as you have enough talent, you can enter the academy to study.

So in a sense, Tiandi Academy has almost no rivals in the Immortal Realm.

Of course, all of this is based on the fact that Tiandi Academy has strong strength, and the resources in Tiandi Academy are rich.

This has created the current status of Di Academy in the Immortal Realm.

But although Tiandi Academy is strong, the ancient family is not an ordinary force.

If you really fight, the ancient family is not afraid of Tiandi Academy.

Originally, Xiao Luo was in the academy, and as long as Xiao Luo did not leave the academy, the people of the three tribes could not do anything to Xiao Luo.

After all, the academy needs to maintain the rules of the academy, so how could Xiao Luo be killed in the academy?

With the protection of the academy, when Xiao Luo grows up, he still has a chance to take revenge.

But now, Xiao Luo left the academy and returned to the Xiao clan.

Now, Xiao Jing's last glimmer of hope was shattered.

However, Xiao Luo had no regrets.

"Great Elder, I, Xiao Luo, can't practice quietly even though I know my family is in trouble."

"Xiao clan, I must come back."

"This is my home. I, Xiao Luo, are willing to live and die with the Xiao clan!"

Xiao Luo's sonorous and powerful voice sounded from the field and entered the hearts of the Xiao clan.

"Young Master Xiao Luo, you,"

At this moment, Xiao Jing didn't know what to say.

"Great Elder, forget it, nothing you say now is useless."

On the side, Xiao Chen smiled bitterly.

Seeing Xiao Chen, Xiao Luo asked, "Second Elder, I heard that you found two masters to resolve the crisis for my Xiao clan?"

Hearing this, Xiao Chen was stunned for a moment, then nodded slightly.

"This is indeed the case."

"What about them?"

Xiao Chen turned around and looked at the mountain behind him, "He has already entered."

Suddenly, Xiao Luo looked solemn.

.........

"Hey~ It's so gloomy."

Lu Xue was walking on the mountain road, looking at the fog around her, frowning.

She found that the fog on this mountain was not a simple fog, it could actually isolate the perception of the practitioner.

With his current cultivation level, his spiritual consciousness can only be used within one meter, almost the same as a blind man.

Here, she has no idea about time.

"Xiaoqing, Xiaoqing?"

Lu Xue began to call Xiaoqing.

The next moment, a dragon head poked out from Lu Xue's cuff.

"My master, what's wrong?"

"It's okay, I'm just a little lonely. By the way, how long have I been in?"

Lu Xue asked.

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing did not hesitate, "My little master, it's only half a day."

"Half-day?"

Lu Xue frowned slightly. She thought she had been away for many days, but she didn't expect that it was only half a day.

"How do you know?"

"I counted one by one."

Lu Xue:...

"Awesome."

Lu Xue gave Ao Qing a thumbs up.

There is really no one else.

Immediately, Lu Xue continued to walk aimlessly forward.

At this time, Lu Xue didn't know that in the dark, several pairs of eyes were staring at Lu Xue.

"Kill?"

In the dark, a phantom looked at Lu Xue and spoke.

On the side, another phantom was silent for a moment and slowly shook his head.

"She has no threat."

After all, Lu Xue is just an immortal king.

Ao Qing on her arm just gave them a little more interest.

But that's all.
